import json
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer

import openai_client

received = {}

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers[\"Content-Length\"])
        received[\"payload\"] = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length))
        received[\"authorization\"] = self.headers.get(\"Authorization\")
        received[\"content_type\"] = self.headers.get(\"Content-Type\")
        body = json.dumps({
            \"output\": [
                {
                    \"type\": \"message\",
                    \"content\": [
                        {\"type\": \"output_text\", \"text\": \"Hello \"},
                        {\"type\": \"output_text\", \"text\": \"there.\"},
                    ],
                }
            ]
        }).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")
        self.send_header(\"Content-Length\", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        pass

server = HTTPServer((\"127.0.0.1\", 0), Handler)
thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
thread.start()
try:
    client = openai_client.OpenAIClient(
        \"test-key\",
        endpoint=f\"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}/v1/responses\",
    )
    result = client.send_text_prompt(
        \"Private prompt\",
        instructions=\"Be brief.\",
        extra_body={\"store\": True, \"max_output_tokens\": 32},
    )
    assert result == \"Hello there.\", result
    assert received[\"payload\"][\"input\"] == \"Private prompt\"
    assert received[\"payload\"][\"instructions\"] == \"Be brief.\"
    assert received[\"payload\"][\"model\"] == openai_client.DEFAULT_MODEL
    assert received[\"payload\"][\"max_output_tokens\"] == 32
    assert received[\"payload\"][\"store\"] is False
    assert received[\"authorization\"] == \"Bearer test-key\"
    assert received[\"content_type\"] == \"application/json\"
finally:
    server.shutdown()
    thread.join(timeout=2)

print(\"local mock integration: ok\")
